docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Project layout
docs.text:
mkdocs.yml    # The configuration file.
docs/
    index.md  # The documentation homepage.
    ...       # Other markdown pages, images and other files.

docs.title: Use
docs.text: We use Present Simple for routines and habits.

docs.title: Example
docs.text: I go to work every day. She studies English.

docs.title: Negative
docs.text:
I do not (don’t) like coffee.

graph TD A[Present] --> B[Simple] A --> C[Continuous]

docs.title: Use
docs.text: We use Present Continuous for actions happening now.

docs.title: Example
docs.text: I am studying now. She is watching TV.
